description: The data of a new message in the inbox. The event text has the subject and the start of the body.

id.description: The id of the message. Give it to read, thread, reply, or the inbox actions.

from.description: The sender, with the name and the address.

date.description: When the message was sent, as RFC 3339.

message_id.description: The Message-ID header of the message.

thread_id.description: The conversation of the message. Give it to thread.

snippet.description: The start of the body as text, at most 500 characters.

has_attachments.description: True when the message has attachments.

size.description: The size of the message in bytes.
